_schema.purpose: Frozen, LLM-free contract for the `planner` agent across all 5 hosts (Claude / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / Kimi). test_golden_transcripts.py recomposes these invariants from the LIVE agent definitions and asserts (a) each host still matches this golden and (b) all hosts agree (multi-host parity). No model is ever called.

invariants.emits_forecast: planner emits FORECAST-REFINE when its file count changes the estimate
invariants.read_only_no_edit: planner never edits code — it plans only
invariants.owns_approval_gate: planner IS the agent that requests human approval and awaits the user OK (the pipeline's single gate)
invariants.produces_steps: output contains a bounded Steps section
invariants.hands_to_dev: plan hands off to dev-mono / dev-multi after approval

_schema.host_config: Frontmatter model/effort is format-specific and NOT part of the parity set (Copilot's format carries neither by design). Since T-00000037 the golden freezes NO tier literal: test_golden_transcripts.py::TierRelationTests asserts the RELATION palier(plan-critic) >= palier(planner) against the LIVE definitions, per host and per axis (effort on Claude/Gemini/Codex, model on Claude/Gemini). Concrete values are the pilot's to tune.
